summary: acer nitro 16 gaming laptop has thermal throttling and battery drain issues in performance/turbo mode due to power brick reliability concerns.
detected_fault: Power brick reliability issue causing thermal throttling and battery drain, likely due to inadequate cooling or faulty components.
suggested_solution: Upgrade to a 230W power brick, flash the VBios, and consider undervolting the GPU using software like MSI Afterburner or EVGA Precision X.
